items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Because Captain Joe, they used to send Captain Joe music by the month. They sent him a stack of music and they'd bill him for it, you see. So we used to get music first.

ctx.x: We were familiar with the number, we got the number on the boat before they got it. Because Captain Joe, they used to send Captain Joe music by the month. They sent him a stack of music and they'd bill him for it, you see. So we used to get music first. The boats used to get music first. So when the other guys got it, we'd be playing in about three weeks.
What kind of a place was it? Was it a big dance hall?
